# Coder-B Apps

> Official product information, support documentation, and privacy policies for apps made by Coder-B.

## Featured app

- [Gentle Bye](https://coder-b.github.io/App/GentleBye/): An iPhone and iPad kids video timer that helps parents select public YouTube videos, set a total viewing-time limit, and guide a calm transition when the session ends.
- [Download Gentle Bye](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/gentle-bye-kids-timer/id6821336171): Official Apple App Store listing for Gentle Bye: Kids Timer on iPhone and iPad. See the listing for current pricing and compatibility.
- [Gentle Bye support](https://coder-b.github.io/App/GentleBye/support.html): Setup instructions, product behavior, frequently asked questions, and troubleshooting.
- [Gentle Bye privacy policy](https://coder-b.github.io/App/GentleBye/privacy.html): Data collection, providers, retention, choices, and deletion requests.

## Important facts about Gentle Bye

- Parents select every video and arrange the queue.
- A session uses one total viewing-time limit inside Gentle Bye; it does not block other apps or limit all device screen time.
- Gentle reminders begin during the final 90 seconds.
- The app does not require a name, email address, or password.
- Search uses YouTube's strict SafeSearch setting, but parents should review every video.
- Gentle Bye is independent and is not affiliated with or endorsed by YouTube or Google.
- The product page explains research on children's understanding of time words and technology-triggered screen-time endings, with links to the original studies and educator guidance.
- Kids Mode pairs a countdown with a train-and-track visual and a next-activity prompt; the app pauses playback when the parent-set time limit is reached.
- The cited research does not establish that Gentle Bye reduces tantrums, validate its 90-second reminders, or prove automatic app timers outperform parent-triggered endings.

## Afterlook

- [Afterlook](https://coder-b.github.io/App/Afterlook/): An iPhone app that turns room photos into AI renovation previews, estimates, product ideas, and shareable before-and-after proposals.
- [Download Afterlook](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/afterlook/id6779862210): Official App Store listing.
- [AI renovation preview guide](https://coder-b.github.io/App/Afterlook/renovation-preview-guide.html): What AI renovation previews are, how accurate they are, how to take a useful photo, and how to use previews and estimates responsibly.
- [Afterlook support](https://coder-b.github.io/App/Afterlook/support.html): Features, setup instructions, FAQs, and troubleshooting.
- [Afterlook privacy policy](https://coder-b.github.io/App/Afterlook/privacy.html): Photo processing, storage, sharing, retention, and deletion information.
- [Afterlook comparison — Option A: Light Oak](https://afterlook.swayra.app/share/47153d02-09b9-417c-86d3-44f45a47f234): A real shared renovation preview with a $2,075.20 estimate.
- [Afterlook comparison — Option B: Dark Walnut](https://afterlook.swayra.app/share/f7f47ee9-e6c4-4ecd-b84b-27a5f9aa8f32): A real shared renovation preview with a $2,072.96 estimate.

### Important facts about Afterlook

- Users can apply materials, colors, and finishes to selected areas of a room photo.
- Multiple changes can be layered and reverted.
- Estimates can include quantities, unit prices, contingency, labor, permits, and other costs.
- Shared project links open in a browser; recipients do not need the app.
- Afterlook is available for iPhone and requires iOS 18.6 or later.
